nodes.description: Ownable.owner: privileged address controlling the Allow/Copyright contracts; set to msg.sender in the constructor and reassigned by transferOwnership.
Allow.allowedMap: mapping(address => bool) access-control whitelist consulted via allowedMap[msg.sender] in the allow modifier.
Allow.allowedArray: dynamic array of allowed addresses, appended in allowAccess and iterated for duplicate detection.
Copyright.list: bytes32[] registry of saved hashes, pushed in save and read in count.
Ownable constructor: initializes owner with msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner) access gate applied to owner-only functions.
transferOwnership(address newOwner): onlyOwner function that reassigns the owner state variable.
Allow constructor: empty, only triggers Ownable constructor chain.
allow modifier: require(allowedMap[msg.sender] == true) whitelist gate applied to save().
allowAccess(address _address): onlyOwner function that whitelists an address in allowedMap and appends it to allowedArray if absent.
denyAccess(address _address): onlyOwner function that removes an address from the allowedMap whitelist.
Copyright constructor: empty, inherits Allow/Ownable initialization.
save(bytes32 _hash): allow-gated function that pushes a hash into list and emits SetLog with index list.length-1.
count(): public view returning list.length.
msg.sender used in Ownable constructor as the initial privileged owner.
msg.sender used in onlyOwner require comparison against owner.
msg.sender used as the key in allowedMap[msg.sender] inside the allow modifier.
msg.sender emitted as the _handler argument in the AddressAllowed event inside allowAccess.
msg.sender emitted as the _handler argument in the AddressDenied event inside denyAccess.
owner = msg.sender: privileged-state assignment; access control depends solely on caller identity.
require(msg.sender == owner): authorization check guarding all onlyOwner functions.
require(allowedMap[msg.sender] == true): whitelist authorization check guarding save().
list.length - 1: arithmetic on array length used as the event id; underflow risk on empty array.
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership, validated != address(0) and assigned to owner.
_address parameter of allowAccess, written into allowedMap and pushed into allowedArray.
_address parameter of denyAccess, cleared from allowedMap.
_hash parameter of save, pushed into the list registry.
exists boolean local in allowAccess tracking whether _address is already in allowedArray.
i loop index in allowAccess used to scan allowedArray.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is the sole parameter of transferOwnership and is only used as its local input; merge it into the function node to reduce parameter noise.
_address is the sole parameter of allowAccess; its effects (whitelist write and array push) are summarized by the function node.
_address is the sole parameter of denyAccess and is fully captured by the function node.
_hash is the sole parameter of save and is fully captured by the function node.
exists is a function-scoped lookup flag that carries no independent security semantics beyond allowAccess.
i is a trivial loop counter inside allowAccess and can be merged into the function node.
